mass.title: Mass and balance
mass.summary: The aircraft weighs 472 g. Its centre of gravity is at x = -6 mm (forward positive, measured from the CAD origin). The masses are estimates.

cg_mm.label: Centre of gravity (x forward, y left, z up)

inertia_kgm2.label: Inertia about the centre of gravity

propulsion.title: Propulsion
propulsion.summary: At full throttle each rotor pulls 7.7 N (31 N in total, 73 A from the battery). It hovers at 31 % throttle using 4.6 A, which gives about 16 minutes on the usable battery. These numbers rest on typical values, not datasheets.

thrust_max_n.label: Thrust of one rotor at full throttle (static)

motor_current_margin.label: Motor rating divided by motor current at full throttle

esc_current_margin.label: Speed-controller rating divided by motor current at full throttle

battery_current_margin.label: Battery rating (capacity x C) divided by current at full throttle

tw_ratio.label: Thrust to weight at full throttle

hover_endurance_min.label: Hover time on the usable battery

structure.title: Structure
structure.summary: The weakest arm (arm_fl) has a safety factor of 12.3 at 2 x full thrust (peak stress 49 MPa against 600 MPa yield, bends 2.0 mm). Material or thrust data are estimates.

parts.load: root end fixed; 15.4 N (2 x 7.69 N x 1 rotor) along the rotor axis on the 40 surface nodes nearest the motor position; arm self-weight ignored

flight.title: Hover flight
flight.summary: After a 15 degree roll kick the aircraft levelled out in 1.5 s, peak tilt 15 degrees, drifting at most 17 cm; throttle headroom 83 %. Model: motor lag 50 ms and rotor torque ratio from cp/ct are estimates; no drag or wind.

extra.frame: x forward, y left, z up; att = roll, pitch, yaw (deg)
assumptions: rotor reaction torque k_q = cp / (2 pi ct) * D (estimate)
settled = tilt < 2 deg and position error < 0.15 m
